cards.title: Mother-in-law's girly clothes for daughter
cards.body: A parent struggles with a mother-in-law's overly feminine clothing choices for their daughter. Advice columnist Eleanor Gordon-Smith explores the risk of swinging too far in the opposite direction when raising girls away from traditional gender norms.

cards.title: Parenting failures revealed at Ikea
cards.body: Zoe Williams reflects on shopping at Ikea with her son and discovering how little domestic wisdom she's imparted. The experience becomes a humorous reckoning with parenting choices.

cards.title: Crush on teacher at children's school
cards.body: A married parent with two children seeks advice about developing feelings for a teacher at their school. Annalisa Barbieri explores whether crushes operating outside everyday life justify acting on them.

cards.title: Parental burnout and special needs
cards.body: Parents of special needs children experience unique burnout challenges that impact relationships and wellbeing. Learn why parent burnout happens and strategies to recharge without guilt.

cards.title: Stop blaming kids for addictive tech
cards.body: Rather than blaming children for excessive screen use, examine the technology deliberately designed to capture their attention. The machinery behind screens teaches developing brains problematic patterns about attention, reward, and stress.

cards.title: What is the screen replacing?
cards.body: Before limiting your child's screen time, consider what the screen is actually replacing in their life. This question reveals deeper patterns about their needs and development.

cards.title: Breaking the anxiety cycle in kids
cards.body: Better breathing techniques can help calm tension and interrupt anxious thinking in children. Learn cyclic sighing and other methods to help kids manage stress and anxiety.

cards.title: Blind parents experience baby scans
cards.body: New innovations help blind parents experience ultrasound scans of their babies through alternative formats. These workarounds address challenges blind parents face in prenatal care.
